policies.text: Transport efficiency benchmarks are satisfied when a customs-expedited firm keeps its average ground handling time under 60 minutes per month.
Carrier standing at the primary level is attained either with an active fleet of at least 10 aircraft or by executing a minimum of 150 completed flights per month.
Strategic maritime status is granted to any shipping firm maintaining a fleet size of at least 20 vessels.
Expedited customs treatment is granted to a recognized primary operator that maintains ISO 28000 supply chain security certification.
Awarding a priority freight contract requires an operational efficiency verified entity holding cargo insurance coverage of at least 2000000 USD.
Preferred overland status is awarded to haulage operators maintaining a driver safety rating of at least 85 points.
Fast-track border routing is granted to any transport vendor possessing an Authorized Economic Operator certificate.
Cold storage facility approval is granted to warehouses maintaining a continuous temperature log accuracy of 99 percent.
A rail operator receives green routing certification when maintaining a renewable energy usage ratio of at least 70 percent.
